title: Cozy Deodeok Root Stew
description: A comforting and nourishing stew that combines the earthy sweetness of deodeok root with the warmth of traditional portuguese flavors.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced chorizo sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic and cook until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced deodeok root and cubed potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, white wine (if using), salt, and pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
